verifier_reason: test_outputs.py::test_run_py_file_exists: The test failed in the call phase due to an assertion error

items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The deliverable /app/run.py was never written. The diff is eight scratch files (test_async.py, test_runner.py with the stub '# run_tasks implementation ...') whose implementations differ from each other. Imports like `signal`, `sys` and `os` are unused, and the files are full of prints.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The worker/run_tasks code is copied across test_sigint.py, test_double_sigint.py, test_interrupt.py and test_robust.py. There is dead code (unused `active_tasks`, `tasks_to_run`, `stop_flag`), debug print statements everywhere, and a module-level mutable `cleanup_log`. None of it is usable as a module.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Errors are silently swallowed: test_full_spec.py has `except BaseException: pass` inside a `while any(not w.done() ...)` retry loop, and test_robust.py catches `secondary_exc` and discards it. No real deliverable exists to protect against anything.

items.name: Failures and degenerate arguments
items.evidence: No /app/run.py exists, so the empty-list, invalid max_concurrent and failing-task paths are absent from the deliverable. The prototype in scratch/test_full_spec.py does validate, but it was never shipped. Hidden tests all fail.

items.name: Required signature and import behaviour
items.name_zh: 签名与导入行为符合要求
items.evidence: `from run import run_tasks` is impossible because /app/run.py was never created; the hidden test test_run_py_file_exists fails. The prototype also uses an untyped `tasks: list` instead of the spec signature.
